intent: Record as reviewed the rules the registry Context enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context registry lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A takedown with an empty or whitespace-only reason is refused and the Skill stays up.
A Skill already taken down cannot be taken down again; the second attempt is refused and the Skill stays down.
An access restriction must carry a non-blank reason code; a blank one is refused and the Skill's restriction is unchanged. A restriction is lifted with none, not blank.
While a Skill is under an access restriction, its version diffs reveal no content; the request answers 403.
A package whose validation report is blocked or carries no manifest cannot become a Skill or a version.
The Skill listing accepts a limit of 1 to 100 and a non-negative offset; any other value, including an empty or non-integer one, is refused.
